newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ING Barings named Argentine debt market-maker.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings named Argentine debt market-maker.

text.p: Dutch financial services company ING Barings has been added to the list of Argentine treasury bond and bill market-makers, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
ING Barings will replaces Banco Credito Argentino which was dropped from the list.
The change comes after the ministry's annual review of the eligibility of the market-makers. The criteria to be a market-maker include volume traded in the market and amounts bought at debt auctions.
The current market-makers will last until March 3, 1998.

The ministry also made public the ranking of the 12 market-makers. Morgan Guaranty Trust Co. headed the ranking, with Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires in second place and Deutsche Bank in third. ING was fourth.
